001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.general;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.QSCancellable;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
006import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
007import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
009import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
010
011/**
012 * Calling when control panel opened for
013 */
014public class ShopControlPanelOpenEvent extends AbstractQSEvent implements QSCancellable {
015
016  private final Shop shop;
017  private final CommandSender sender;
018  private boolean cancelled = false;
019  private @Nullable Component cancelReason;
020
021  /**
022   * Called before shop control panel message.
023   *
024   * @param shop   The shop bought from
025   * @param sender The player which receiving shop control panel message
026   */
027  public ShopControlPanelOpenEvent(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final CommandSender sender) {
028
029    this.shop = shop;
030    this.sender = sender;
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  public @Nullable Component getCancelReason() {
035
036    return this.cancelReason;
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  public void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final Component reason) {
041
042    this.cancelled = cancel;
043    this.cancelReason = reason;
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Get the sender that opened control panel
048   *
049   * @return The sender
050   */
051  public CommandSender getSender() {
052
053    return this.sender;
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Gets the shop of control panel opened
058   *
059   * @return The shop
060   */
061  public Shop getShop() {
062
063    return this.shop;
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  public boolean isCancelled() {
068
069    return cancelled;
070  }
071}
